page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-96-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 756.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with 45097 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 12 local SSD drives, providing high-capacity, low-latency local storage. It does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its massive local NVMe storage capacity and high memory allocation, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile designed for resource-intensive data workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects its high resource density, particularly the substantial local SSD footprint. This configuration is optimized for large-scale databases, high-throughput transactional systems, real-time analytics, and data warehousing applications that require rapid local read and write operations alongside significant memory capacity.
